_source: D:/New Trading app services/account_risk_service.py (env names and defaults) + services/risk/account_guard.py (rules)
_note: live_default = the value to use with real money. paper_now = what the desktop sandbox runs with; three limits were raised for paper only and MUST go back to live_default before any live trading.
applies_to: every new entry, across all strategies on the account; exits bypass everything except the kill switch

ACCOUNT_MAX_TRADES_TODAY.counts: every order sent: entry, resting stop and exit

ACCOUNT_MAX_DRAWDOWN_PCT.meaning: equity this % below the persisted peak refuses entries and engages the kill switch

ACCOUNT_STARTING_CAPITAL.meaning: 0 disables the drawdown-vs-capital leg; the vs-peak leg still works

ACCOUNT_PEAK_FILE.meaning: peak equity persisted across days; re-base it when going live

ACCOUNT_ENTRY_CUTOFF_MINUTES.meaning: no new entries this many minutes before the 15:15 square-off

revert_before_live: re-base the stored peak equity to the live balance
